name: Armodrillo
abilities: Biological jackhammer arms - tremors, fissures and earthquakes
Drill hands and rapid tunnelling through solid rock
Immense strength (lifted Mucilator, launched Trombipulor over buildings, destroyed ten Dimension 12 robots)
Piston-boosted punches; jackhammer propulsion into the air
Shock-wave generation; 'shock wave blender' spinning drills
Armoured body (thrown through walls without harm)
Body vibration to counter sonic weapons (Andreas)
weaknesses: Certain weapons make his arm vibrate uncontrollably
Weak against Slammoids (dig him out, pierce joints, dissolve armour with acid)
Vulnerable to electricity and Argit's quills
Can be suffocated if buried and compressed
summary: A ten-foot yellow armadillo with jackhammer arms that shake the earth, drill through rock, and punch hard enough to level buildings.
notableFeats: Helped Captain Nemesis beat Computron's minions in his debut (Hero Time)
Battled Ultimate Kevin (...Nor Iron Bars a Cage)
Cleared out Psyphon's henchmen (The More Things Change: Part 2)
Fought Slamworm and Crabdozer (Of Predators and Prey: Part 2, Malefactor)
Fought Zombozo, Fistrick and Trombipulor (Special Delivery)
His arm let Humungousaur disintegrate a tree and Whampire fight Malgax via Skurd (Stuck on You, Malgax Attacks)

appearances.designNotes: Yellow armoured body, Corinthian-helmet head with two ears, grey tail, jackhammer parts on elbows/wrists/hands, grey feet; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.
Longer ears, grey bolts with black markings on shoulders, metal circle on head, larger arm-drills, yellow feet with grey toes, chain-like limb segments, bulkier forearms/shoulders; Omnitrix on chest.

scoring.rationale: Strength 8 with jackhammer punches that toss Trombipulor over rooftops and quakes that shake whole streets; burrows freely and wears heavy armour. Purely physical, slow, and Slammoids/electricity/quills all counter him.

notes: Also used by Albedo (Negative Armodrillo, For a Few Brains More) and No Watch Ben (And Then There Was Ben) - not counted in usedBy.
OV Ben Again use was 11-year-old Ben's mind in 16-year-old Ben's body (counted as ben-16-ov).
UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
